caption.zh: 1984 年论文的声称、前提与不提供：随机密钥分发是声称，公开信道不可篡改是前提，数字签名与争议裁决明确不在论文范围。
caption.en: What the 1984 paper claims, assumes, and does not provide: random-key distribution is claimed; an unalterable public channel is assumed; digital signatures and dispute adjudication are explicitly outside the paper.

alt.zh: 三栏卡片：论文声称量子信道加普通经典信道可分发随机密钥；论文前提是公开信道可被窃听但不可注入/篡改、密钥一次性用完、量子传输不能放大；论文不提供数字签名、认证邮件、法官面前的争议裁决。底部摘录两句原文。
alt.en: Three cards: the paper claims a quantum channel plus an ordinary classical channel can distribute a random key; it assumes the public channel may be eavesdropped but not injected/altered, the key is used once, and quantum signals cannot be amplified; it does not provide digital signatures, certified mail, or dispute adjudication before a judge. Two quotations sit below.

caption.zh: 两张信道，两种信任：量子信道传单光子且测量会扰动；公开经典信道可被被动窃听但不能被注入或篡改，主动攻击需预先共享小密钥认证。
caption.en: Two channels, two trust assumptions: the quantum channel carries single photons and measurement disturbs them; the public classical channel may be passively eavesdropped but not injected or altered, and active attack requires a pre-shared small key for authentication.

alt.zh: 上下两条信道：上方 Alice 发单光子到 Bob，Eve 测量会产生扰动；下方 Alice 与 Bob 在公开经典信道上公布基和比对子集，标注可被动窃听、不可注入/篡改；底部说明主动攻击需预共享小密钥认证。
alt.en: Two channel lanes: above, Alice sends single photons to Bob and Eve’s measurement causes disturbance; below, Alice and Bob announce bases and compare a subset over the public classical channel, marked as passively eavesdroppable but not injectable/alterable; the footer notes active attack needs a pre-shared small key for authentication.

caption.zh: 同一篇论文：1984 年 12 月 Bangalore 会议论文集第 175–179 页；2014 年 Theoretical Computer Science 560 卷 7–11 页重印。
caption.en: One paper: the Bangalore proceedings, pages 175–179, in December 1984; the 2014 reprint in Theoretical Computer Science 560, pages 7–11.

alt.zh: 两节点时间线：1984 年节点注明 12 月 10–12 日 Bangalore、Proc. ICSSP 第 175–179 页；2014 年节点注明 TCS 560 第 7–11 页、同一文本；底部说明重印不是再次提出。
alt.en: Two-node timeline: the 1984 node gives 10–12 December, Bangalore, Proc. ICSSP pages 175–179; the 2014 node gives TCS 560 pages 7–11 and the same text; the footer says a reprint is not a second proposal.

zh.principle: **事件**：BB84 论文发表（1984）（The BB84 Paper Published (1984)）。
zh.why: 论文的动因是：量子测量会扰动非正交态，因此窃听会留下痕迹。摘要写：「When elementary quantum systems, such as polarized photons, are used to transmit digital information, the uncertainty principle gives rise to novel cryptographic phenomena unachievable with traditional transmission media」；其中一种现象是「a communications channel on which it is impossible in principle to eavesdrop without a high probability of disturbing the transmission in such a way as to be detected」。论文进一步主张：「Such a quantum channel can be used in conjunction with ordinary insecure classical channels to distribute random key information between two users with the assurance that it remains unknown to anyone else, even when the users share no secret information initially.」。这三句把为什么限定为物理层的可检测扰动，不把它扩展成计算安全的证明。
zh.used: 论文把产出定位为一次性密码本的密钥或认证标签，而不是直接加密消息。它写：双方可「use these shared secret bits in the well-known way as a one-time pad to conceal the meaning of subsequent meaningful communications, or for other cryptographic applications (e.g.authentication tags) requiring shared secret random information」。同时明确边界：「quantum cryptography does not provide digital signatures, or applications such as certified mail or the ability to settle disputes before a judge」。因此该条目只记录论文提出的用途：密钥分发与认证标签；不把 BB84 写成签名、PKI 或通用加密协议。
zh.broken: 论文的检测论证有明确前提。公开信道「assumed to be susceptible to eavesdropping but not to the injection or alteration of messages」；若攻击者能主动改公开消息，协议需要预先共享小密钥做认证：「The need for the public (non-quantum) channel in this scheme to be immune to active eavesdropping can be relaxed if Alice and Bob have agreed beforehand on a small secret key」。量子侧则用误码检测：Eve 全用 R 基拦截-重发时，「the eavesdropper measures and retransmits all intercepted photons in the rectilinear basis, thereby learning the correct polarizations of half the photons and inducing disagreements in 1/4」。所以能检测依赖抽样与认证，不是无条件保证。
zh.history: 重印本脚注把原载位置记作「This paper appeared originally on pages 175–179 of the Proceedings of the International Conference on Computers, Systems and Signal Processing」，并说明重印「exactly as it was in its original 1984 version, except for fresh typesetting」。这两句给出 1984 年会议论文集、第 175–179 页与 2014 年重印之间的关系；结合论文首页的会议行与起始页 175，该条目把事件断到 1984 年 12 月会议论文发表。2014 年是同一文本的排版重印，不是协议再次提出。
